hero.description: BhoomiDrishti helps transform land-claim information and supporting evidence into structured, transparent and actionable insights. By synthesizing multi-temporal satellite records, cadastral boundary overlays, and documentary submissions, the platform assists public administration committees in making well-informed, evidence-backed assessments.
